result:
I implemented `Date.prototype.toLocaleString` in `prototype_to_locale_string.rs`. It throws a TypeError if `this` isn't a Date and returns `"Invalid Date"` for NaN. Otherwise it returns the local date and time as `Www Mmm DD YYYY HH:MM:SS`, ignoring the reserved arguments.

Clippy is clean and `./t262 built-ins/Date/prototype/toLocaleString/` passes 8/8. That is the same 8 as before, because no test there exercises the function body, so the run can't show any new passes.
